# hoGAMEGATA (hGG) — Full System & Metadata Specification

## 1. Executive Summary & Creator Background
- **Site Name**: hoGAMEGATA (also known as hGG or gamegata db)
- **Domain**: https://gamegata.xyz
- **Creator / Developer**: **aurostron** (Solo Developer)
- **Development History**: GAMEGATA was created by **aurostron** as a casual summer break project while learning web development and database engineering. It quickly evolved into a massive hobby project—standing today as one of the very first and largest open-access horror video game metadata registries. GAMEGATA is **aurostron**'s first public web project.
- **Primary Function**: The largest dedicated open metadata registry, preservation catalog, and discovery engine for horror video games.
- **Current Inventory**:
  - 107,800+ Horror Game Records
  - 68,000+ Game Developers and Studios
  - 5,600+ Publishers
  - 15,800+ Micro-Genre & Thematic Tags
  - 430,000+ Screenshots & Media Assets
  - 95,000+ Live Store Pricing & Discount Snapshots
- **Monetization / Business Model**: Non-commercial, 100% free, no ads, no trackers, no subscription paywalls.

## 2. Genre Taxonomy & Tag Structure
hoGAMEGATA categorizes horror games across extensive dimensions:
- **Survival Horror**: Resource management, inventory puzzles, limited ammunition, fixed/over-the-shoulder perspective (e.g., Silent Hill, Resident Evil, Signalis, Crow Country).
- **Psychological Horror**: Sanity mechanics, hallucinations, unreliable narrators, atmospheric dread (e.g., Amnesia, Visage, Layers of Fear, Cry of Fear).
- **Retro / PS1 / Low-Poly Horror**: Nostalgic 90s aesthetic, dithering, tank controls, CRT filters (e.g., Puppet Combo, Chilla's Art, Dread X Collections).
- **Body & Cosmic Horror**: Visceral mutations, Lovecraftian entities, unknowable dread (e.g., Dead Space, The Thing, Call of Cthulhu, The Shore).
- **Found Footage / Analog Horror**: VHS distortions, surveillance cameras, bodycam POV (e.g., The Exit 8, Outlast, Welcome to the Game).
- **Indie & Short-Form Terror**: Itch.io and Game Jolt experiential horrors, Ludum Dare game jam entries.

## 3. Technology Stack & Edge Architecture
- **Framework**: Astro 5 (Hybrid SSR & Prerendered Static Edge Architecture)
- **Runtime**: Cloudflare Workers / Cloudflare Pages Edge Runtime
- **Database**: Turso LibSQL (Distributed globally replicated SQLite) & Better Auth
- **Search Engine**: In-memory prefix B-Tree indexing with fallback Edge DSL Query engine.

## 4. Key Endpoints & Routing
- `/` — Homepage featuring curated spotlights, trending horrors, newest releases, top-rated games, and real-time database telemetry.
- `/games` — Full dynamic catalog browser with filter drawers and responsive grid/list views.
- `/game/[slug]` — Individual game profiles with high-res screenshots, release timelines, developer links, Linux/Proton compatibility, deal snapshots, and similar recommendations.
- `/developer/[slug]` — Developer bibliography and release history.
- `/upcoming` — Calendar of announced horror releases.
- `/directory` — Alphabetical index of all registered titles.
- `/api/stats` — Live JSON telemetry providing exact counts of games, developers, publishers, tags, screenshots, and deals.
- `/api/games?search=[term]` — Instant search API.
- `/api/search/ai` — AI-powered natural language query parsing.
